Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

extend verb

stretch, reach as far as

also reach as far as, stretch as far as, run as far as

classical

Caes. BG 6.10.5: hanc longē intrōrsus pertinēre
Cic. N.D. 2.136: ad pulmōnēs usque pertinet (Lewis & Short)

pertineō, pertinēre, pertinuī

verb, second conjugation

reach, extend (to)

Other words

  • pateō, patēre, patuī — extend, stretch out (over an area)

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.2.5: in lātitūdinem CLXXX patēbant

  • tendō, tendere, tetendī, tentum — stretch, extend (towards)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 201: Tenditne mōns Apennīnus ad merīdiānās regiōnēs Ītaliae?

Examples

  • angustōs sē fīnēs habēre arbitrābantur, quī in longitūdinem mīlia passuum CCXL, in lātitūdinem CLXXX patēbant

    they thought their territory too small, though it extended two hundred and forty miles in length and a hundred and eighty in breadthCaes. BG 1.2.5

  • silvam esse ibi īnfīnītā magnitūdine … hanc longē intrōrsus pertinēre

    that there was a forest there of boundless size … that it stretched far inlandCaes. BG 6.10.5

  • Tenditne mōns Apennīnus ad merīdiānās regiōnēs Ītaliae?

    Does the Apennine range extend to the southern regions of Italy?Traupman 201

See also extend, range, wide.
